content: - Evaluates the performance of the systems at predicting whether each token is sensitive or non-sensitive; that is, the measurements only take into account whether a sensitive token has been recognised or not, regardless of the BIO label and the category assigned. This scenario shows how good a system would be at obfuscating sensitive data (e.g., by replacing sensitive tokens with asterisks).
